## Problem

What user or maintainer problem does this solve?

## Change

What changed, and why is this the smallest complete solution?

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. Include screenshots or a short recording for requested UI work.

## Impact

- [ ] Public API or persisted data
- [ ] Model, schema, prediction, feedback, or plugin contract
- [ ] User-visible interface or copy
- [ ] Deployment, environment, or CI configuration
- [ ] None of the above

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR addresses one concern.
- [ ] Behavior and contract changes include focused tests.
- [ ] User or operator documentation is updated when the workflow changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated QA artifacts, or agent scratch files are included.
